title: SWEEP and the 1964 money funnel in Sekret Machines

tellings.quote: But it involves all this money from this huge underground being funneled, hundreds of billions being funneled about the time of 1964.

plain: Around 1964, hundreds of billions of dollars were secretly moved into a huge hidden underground effort, according to the researcher Jason Simosa. He gives this as a summary on Michels' show and credits it to Sekret Machines, a series of books tied to the musician and UFO researcher Tom DeLonge, without naming any other source. If it were true, it would point to a vast secret budget behind UFO work going back to the 1960s.
